query: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, event, count() AS events, uniq(distinct_id) AS ids FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-21 07:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-05 07:00:00') AND event IN ('site_page_viewed','product_tour_cta_clicked','product_tour_started','run_simulated','recovery_step_completed','demo_booking_clicked') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_test),'false') != 'true' GROUP BY day,event ORDER BY day,event
limitations: Counts of events and IDs, not sequential funnels; founders/QA may remain; date grouping UTC; first partial operating week.

windows.query: SELECT multiIf(timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-28 07:00:00'), 'Sep28-Oct4', timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-21 07:00:00'),'Sep21-Sep27','Sep7-Sep20') AS period, event, count(), uniq(distinct_id) FROM events WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-07 07:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-05 07:00:00') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_test),'false') != 'true' AND event IN ('site_page_viewed','product_tour_cta_clicked','product_tour_started','run_simulated','recovery_step_completed','demo_booking_clicked') GROUP BY period,event ORDER BY period,event

paths.query: SELECT properties.$pathname AS path, count() AS views, uniq(distinct_id) AS ids FROM events WHERE event='site_page_viewed' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-28 07:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-05 07:00:00') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_test),'false') != 'true' GROUP BY path ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 15

sources.query: SELECT properties.$referring_domain AS referrer, properties.utm_source AS utm_source, count() AS views, uniq(distinct_id) AS ids FROM events WHERE event='site_page_viewed' AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-09-28 07:00:00') AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-05 07:00:00') AND coalesce(toString(properties.$is_test),'false') != 'true' GROUP BY referrer,utm_source ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 15
